stories.headline: Merz re-elected CDU chairman with 91.2% amid party congress focusing on social policy and unity
stories.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz was re-elected as CDU party chairman with 91.2% of delegates' votes at the party congress in Stuttgart. The congress addressed social media restrictions for children, tax policy, and coalition dynamics with SPD. Technical voting problems delayed proceedings, and Angela Merkel made her first party congress appearance since leaving office.

stories.headline: AfD faces growing nepotism scandal with politicians employing relatives across party network
stories.summary: Multiple AfD politicians are accused of 'Vetternwirtschaft' (nepotism) for employing family members and relatives of party colleagues in parliamentary offices funded by taxpayers. Cases span several federal states including Saxony-Anhalt, Lower Saxony, and North Rhine-Westphalia. The party leadership initiated disciplinary proceedings against some members.

articles.title: AfD-Filz: Neue Vorwürfe – jetzt geht es um Millionen-Betrug im Bundestag!

stories.headline: Lower Saxony constitutional protection service classifies AfD state branch as 'secured right-wing extremist'
stories.summary: The constitutional protection service in Lower Saxony upgraded its classification of the AfD state branch from a 'suspected case' to a 'secured right-wing extremist organization.' This follows similar classifications in other eastern German states and may have consequences for AfD members in civil service positions.

articles.title: AfD in Niedersachsen als extremistische Bestrebung eingestuft
Schwerer Schlag gegen die AfD - jetzt steht es schwarz auf weiß

stories.headline: Political parties plan joint proposal for Federal President succession, likely first female president
stories.summary: CDU/CSU and SPD are working toward a common candidate to succeed Federal President Frank-Walter Steinmeier when his term ends in March 2027. Political leaders express strong preference for Germany's first female Federal President, with speculation about potential candidates from various backgrounds.

articles.title: Lars Klingbeil spricht sich für gemeinsamen Kandidaten von CDU/CSU und SPD aus

stories.headline: Federal President Steinmeier opposes German Olympic bid for 2036 due to Nazi Games history
stories.summary: Federal President Frank-Walter Steinmeier publicly opposed a German bid to host the 2036 Olympics, calling the year 'historically problematic' due to the 100th anniversary of the Nazi propaganda Olympics in 1936. He supports bids for 2040 or 2044 instead. Former Chancellor Schröder publicly disagreed with Steinmeier's position.

articles.title: Olympia 2036: Steinmeier ist gegen Olympische Sommerspiele 2036 in Deutschland

stories.headline: Defense Minister Pistorius faces controversy over drone procurement from company with Peter Thiel investment
stories.summary: Defense Minister Boris Pistorius plans to procure kamikaze drones worth €540 million from two companies, including Stark Defence which has US investor Peter Thiel as a minority shareholder. Parliamentary critics, especially from the Greens, express concerns about Thiel's anti-democratic views and potential influence, though the ministry maintains the investment is unproblematic.

articles.title: Kamikazedrohnen für Bundeswehr: Pistorius muss um Milliardeneinkauf bangen

stories.headline: Government plans major expansion of BND intelligence service operational powers
stories.summary: Chancellery Chief Thorsten Frei announced plans to significantly expand the operational capabilities of Germany's foreign intelligence service (BND), including authority for counter-cyberattacks, sabotage operations abroad, and armed operations. The reforms aim to make Germany a more credible intelligence partner and enable active responses to threats against German interests.

articles.title: Geplante Großreform des BND: Ein bisschen James Bond

stories.headline: Federal President Steinmeier conducts diplomatic visits to Lebanon and Jordan amid Middle East tensions
stories.summary: Federal President Frank-Walter Steinmeier visited Lebanon and Jordan as part of a Middle East diplomatic mission. In Lebanon, he met with President Aoun and other officials, visited the German naval vessel Sachsen-Anhalt participating in UN peacekeeping, and promised continued German support. The visit occurred amid ongoing tensions between Israel and Hezbollah.

articles.title: Bundespräsident Steinmeier besucht Libanon und Jordanien
